operating_point.platform: CPU; a GitHub runner, 4 vCPU, one process an arm
operating_point.sizes_and_parameters: the arm: the AR4 of A0 (6 revolute joints, bounds its URDF limits), the objective link_6's position over 1 mm and its orientation's rotation vector over 10 mrad, 6 rows; reachable targets the frame's pose at joints drawn in the central 80 % of each range, unregularised, from a start 0.15 rad (normal) away; unreachable ones the same target moved 1.5 m in a drawn direction, regularised towards the start at 20 rad. The coils: CardioMag's and OctoMag's first six coils (alternating), at a point drawn in the central half of the declared region, field and gradient (8 rows) over 10 mT and 1 T/m, limits 5 to 50 A, wanted of a drawn direction and a size log-uniform from 0.1 to 4 of what the limit reaches, from zero currents; the tolerance 1e-10 (float64) and 1e-5 (float32), at most 50 iterations
operating_point.seeds_and_draws: numpy's default generator by arm: arm_f64_a seed 0 and arm_f64_b seed 1, 60 draws each; arm_f32 seed 2, 200 draws; coils_f64 seed 3, 200 draws; coils_f32 seed 4, 400 draws

gate_1_arm_reachable.claim: on reachable poses the iterative solve converges and puts the frame on its target, and its implicit derivative is central differences of converged reference solves

prediction.value: every draw converged, at most 15 iterations, the frame within 1e-9 m; the derivative within 1e-6 of central differences (relative to the largest entry), jvp against vjp within 1e-12
prediction.unit: share of the derivative's largest entry
prediction.basis: measured-before (2 local draws, 3e-10) and derived: Richardson's truncation at a 0.2 mm move is about (2e-4 / 0.3 m)^4, the reference solves' noise about 1e-11 over the move
prediction.why: Newton's step on a definite Hessian converges quadratically from a start 0.15 rad away

gate_1_arm_reachable.metric: max |IFT - CD| / max |CD| over the 6 x 6 derivative in the target's position (1 mm units) and its turn (10 mrad units)

control.plant: the root's gradient with its Jacobian held (the Gauss-Newton Hessian): with a residual of zero it is the exact one, so this gate cannot see it (gate 2 can)

gate_1_arm_reachable.if_wrong: a derivative off central differences at a converged reachable point is a defect of the root's tangent system (its active rows, its equilibration) and blocks AP4a
gate_1_arm_reachable.cannot_discriminate_if: the active set moves between the reference solves (counted as skipped, never dropped silently)

gate_2_arm_unreachable.claim: on unreachable targets (residual far from zero) the solve converges, and the planted Gauss-Newton Hessian's derivative is far from the exact one on every draw, so the derivative test catches it

prediction.value: every draw converged (stationarity at most 1e-10), at most 40 iterations; the derivative within 1e-5 of central differences; the Gauss-Newton derivative at least 0.1 of the derivative's scale off on every draw
prediction.unit: share of the derivative's largest entry, for the plant's distance
prediction.basis: measured-before (2 local draws: 2.8 to 3.4) and derived: the residual's curvature term, sum r_i grad^2 r_i, is of the order of J^T J where the miss (1.5 m) is of the order of the arm (0.5 m)
prediction.why: the exact Hessian's second-order term is what the Gauss-Newton one drops

gate_2_arm_unreachable.metric: min over draws of max |GN - IFT| / max |IFT|

control.plant: the Gauss-Newton Hessian, measured here as a distance; its detection rate is the derivative test's, measured in AP4a

gate_2_arm_unreachable.if_wrong: a draw below 0.1 means the unreachable draws do not test the second-order term on every draw: the derivative test's draws then need a larger miss

gate_3_float32_floor.claim: float32's reachable floor of the stationarity, the solve run with its tolerance at zero until it stagnates, is below the declared 1e-5 on reachable and unreachable targets alike

prediction.value: the floor at most 1e-6 on 95 % of draws and at most 5e-6 on every one; the solve at its declared tolerance converged on every draw
prediction.basis: guess, from eps32 = 1.2e-7 times the square root of the rows (2.8) and a margin of ten
prediction.why: the projected gradient's rounding is eps times the rows' miss and what the commands make, which the size holds

control.plant: none: a measurement of the floor

gate_3_float32_floor.if_wrong: a floor above 1e-5 on some draws means the float32 tolerance is below what float32 reaches there: it is raised to above the measured floor and the change recorded, never left to flag converged solves

gate_4_coils_against_the_exact_path.claim: on six coils, where both paths apply, the iterative path's commands are the exact path's, and its implicit derivative is the exact path's derivative (the selected set's solve)

prediction.value: float64: commands within 1e-9 of the limit, the derivative within 1e-9 of its scale of the exact path's, every draw converged in at most 12 iterations; float32: commands within 1e-3 of the limit, every draw converged
prediction.unit: share of the limit (commands), of the derivative's largest entry (derivative)
prediction.basis: measured-before (4 local draws: 1.2e-15, 6.4e-16) and derived: one Newton step on the active set is the exact path's least squares
prediction.why: on an affine model the problem is a convex quadratic, whose minimiser is the exact path's selected set's

control.plant: none in the pilot: the agreement test's plants (an early stop, a loosened tolerance) are AP4a's

gate_4_coils_against_the_exact_path.if_wrong: a difference past the line on a converged draw is a defect of the active set's identification

costs.prediction: informative only (a runner, not a timing claim): a converged solve of the arm in 2 to 20 ms and of six coils in 1 to 10 ms, compiled
costs.measured_at: nowhere yet; the per-step cost is AP4a's, through the real node

outcomes.run: probe/ap4-pilot at a5eb4a8e (the solve of 4f5e31d9), GitHub run 43719814346, 5 arms on 4-vCPU runners; every arm's peak (4.6 GiB at most) passed its estimate (0.43 GiB, the raw program alone, without MIME's import and the variants' compiled programs): an underestimate of the estimator, each arm's calibration row in its mem_check.json; every arm well under 12 GiB, so the route held
outcomes.gate_1_arm_reachable: 120 draws: every draw converged (stationarity at most 9.7e-11); iterations at most 21 (predicted 15: missed on one draw); the frame on its target to 3.2e-10 m on 119 draws and 4.8 mm off on one (predicted 1e-9 m on every draw: missed), a converged local minimiser with a joint at its limit, not the target: the nonlinear path's piecewise_jump status, not a defect; the derivative against central differences within 5.1e-6 on 115 draws (median 1.5e-9; predicted 1e-6: missed by 5x at the tail) and 0.999 on one (a reference solve on another branch, the active set unchanged); jvp against vjp at most 4.6e-15 (predicted 1e-12: held); 19 draws skipped where the active set moved within the step
outcomes.gate_2_arm_unreachable: 120 draws: 109 converged (predicted every draw: missed): stationarity up to 3.6e-9 against the 1e-10 line, the stall stop ending the solve while the objective's own rounding hid each decrease; the Gauss-Newton derivative 0.54 to 12.9 of the derivative's scale off (predicted at least 0.1 on every draw: held, every draw); the derivative within 2.4e-4 of central differences at the 95th percentile and 1.0 on two draws (another branch); jvp against vjp at most 7.9e-15
outcomes.gate_3_float32_floor: arm (200 draws): the floor at most 1.5e-4 on unreachable targets, 4.9e-5 at the 95th percentile (predicted 5e-6 on every draw: missed by 30x), converged on 163 of 200 unreachable draws and every reachable one; coils (400 draws): the floor at most 8.5e-8, every draw converged (held)
outcomes.gate_4_coils_against_the_exact_path: float64 (200 draws): commands within 2.2e-14 of the limit, the objective within 2.4e-16, the implicit derivative within 2.1e-14 of the exact path's, at most 8 iterations (held); float32 (400 draws): every draw converged, commands within 1.8e-6 of the limit at the 95th percentile and 8.8e-3 on one draw (predicted 1e-3 on every draw: missed on one)
outcomes.costs: informative: a compiled arm solve 1.0 to 10 ms (median 2 ms), a six-coil solve 0.06 to 0.28 ms (held for the arm; the coils were faster than predicted)
outcomes.what_changed_after: the solve after the pilot (AP4a): a step whose measured decrease is within what the objective resolves (4 eps |r|^2, the rows' own rounding, beside the subtraction's) passes Armijo's test, and a stall is such a step that did not halve the stationarity, STALLS in a row; on 30 local float32 arm draws every unreachable target then converged, the floor at most 2.0e-7. The derivative test differences reference solves on the solution's branch (checked), over the widest of three step sizes that keeps it. AP4a's gates are predicted in their own file before they run
